title: mzPeak file index JSON
description: Describe the JSON format of the file index

files.description: The files described in the index

metadata.$comment: Deliberate deviations from the spec schema: (1) `version` is not in `required` — HUPO-PSI #17 is open and no current converter writes it (profile resolution warns instead); (2) the version pattern is anchored plain regex — the spec's ECMA named-group form `(?<major>...)` does not compile under Python `re`.

version.description: The mzPeak file format version, formatted as a semantic version

id.description: An optional id for the mzPeak archive used for referencing from external files. It is recommended to use LSIDs when possible.

accession.description: An optional accession number for the mzPeak archive used for storage, e.g. in PRIDE.

imaging.description: Imaging metadata. An archive follows the Imaging profile when `is_imaging` is true.

is_imaging.description: True when the archive follows the Imaging profile.

file.description: A single file in the mzPeak archive of a certain type

name.description: The name of the file, relative to the root of the archive

entity_type.$comment: Controlled values are spelled with underscores, not spaces: `wavelength_spectrum`. A reader encountering a value outside the controlled list treats it as `other`, so this is intentionally not a closed `enum`.
entity_type.description: The things being described in one facet or another by this file

data_kind.$comment: Controlled values are spelled with underscores, not spaces: `data_arrays`, `selected_ions`. A reader encountering a value outside the controlled list treats it as `other`, so this is intentionally not a closed `enum`.
data_kind.description: The facet of the thing being described in this file

column_mapping.description: A list of Parquet column to controlled vocabulary term mappings

parameters.description: A list of parameters describing the file stored in the mzPeak archive itself

checksum.description: The 128 byte SHA-512 hex digest of the entire file, excluding any ZIP-related headers or padding, rendered without byte separators and all alphabetic characters lowercase.

column_mapping.description: A mapping from a Parquet column to a controlled vocabulary term

path.description: The path in a Parquet schema for the mapped column delimited at nesting levels by '.', omitting [list, item|element] tokens

accession.description: The CURIE for the controlled vocabulary term, or null if no controlled vocabulary term is available. Null may be used to indicate that a column has a human readable name but does not map to a controlled vocabulary term

term_marker.description: Whether this column is marks the presence/absence of a specific value-less controlled vocabulary term or subtree. When the column is a string, the value MUST be a CURIE for a child of this mapping's accession. When the column is boolean true when the term is present in the row, false or null otherwise.
